## Terms

### wildcard index

- **wildcard index** · self — Wildcard indexes have specific behavior when the indexed field contains an embedded object (for example, `attributes.secret_feature`). For more information, see [Wildcard Indexes on Embedded Objects and Arrays.](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-wildcard/reference/em · aka: wildcard indexes, wildcard, $**, wildcardProjection, compound wildcard index, compound wildcard indexes, index-wildcard — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-wildcard/create-wildcard-index-single-field.md#results

### hidden index

- **hidden index** · hyponym — Hidden indexes are not used to support queries. If you hide an index and observe substantial negative performance impact, consider keeping and unhiding the index so queries can resume using it. · aka: hidden indexes, hideIndex, unhideIndex, hidden: true, hide an index, unhide — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/manage-indexes.md#remove-indexes

### index build

- **index build** · part — Index builds take exclusive X locks only at start and end, plus a shared S lock during the final side-writes drain. These blocks cover reads, writes, replicated writes and metadata commands on the collection. Writes during the build are held in a side writes table, and key-constraint violations are  · aka: index builds, index creation, build an index, building an index, rolling index build, rolling index builds, hybrid index build, foreground index build, background index build, background: true, in-progress index build, in-flight index build, index build conflict, index build conflicts, concurrent index builds, currentOp index build, killOp index build, index-creation, index-build — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-creation/

### commit quorum

- **commit quorum** · part — Commit quorum is not write concern. It does not guarantee secondary indexes are usable when createIndexes returns. A secondary receiving commitIndexBuild stops applying further oplog entries until its local build commits, so slow builds on secondaries (including ones outside the quorum) cause replic · aka: commitQuorum, setIndexCommitQuorum, votingMembers, index commit quorum, commit quorum: 'majority' — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setindexcommitquorum/

They do not support queries when an indexed field does not exist. ### TTL index

- **TTL index** · hyponym — - If a hidden index is a [TTL index](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md#std-label-index-feature-ttl), the index still expires documents. · aka: TTL indexes, expireAfterSeconds, TTL monitor — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-hidden.md#behavior

### index

- **index** · hypernym — Index creation is a multistage process. The index creation process uses the commit quorum to minimize replication lag on secondary nodes. · aka: indexes, indices, indexing — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setindexcommitquorum/
